title: Tripoli nightly demonstrations against strict lockdown and lack of economic aid
location: Central Tripoli, including Al-Nour/Abdel Hamid Karameh Square and Serail vicinity
scope: Tripoli city; dated gatherings within the reported Jan25–28 sequence need event-unit review
participants_original: Al Jazeera English described hundreds at a Jan27 afternoon gathering. Counts for other nights are not established; no multi-day total is used.
threshold_50_evidence: The Jan27 afternoon crowd is described as hundreds, supporting the threshold for that gathering only, not every night in the series.

start_date.summary: HRW’s day-by-day chronology identifies a Jan25 noon gathering; Al Jazeera’s Feb1 retrospective says protests began Jan25. An Al Jazeera Arabic Jan26 “third day” label conflicts with reporting that calls Jan27 the third night/Jan28 the fourth. Retain the day-count dispute while using Jan25 as best-supported onset.

end_date.summary: Reports describe activity through Jan28; Al Jazeera’s Feb1 story describes Jan31 renewal after a brief lull. Physical closure of the Jan25–28 sequence is unknown.

location.summary: Reports identify Al-Nour/Abdel Hamid Karameh Square, the Serail and nearby government/security buildings in Tripoli.

demands.summary: Reports describe opposition to strict/full lockdown, absence of aid, worsening living conditions, prices and corruption/accountability grievances; demands are not assigned to every night.

participants_original.summary: Al Jazeera English says hundreds at the Jan27 afternoon gathering; this is date- and gathering-specific.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Hundreds” supports 50+ for the Jan27 afternoon gathering only.

protester_violence.summary: Reports describe stone throwing, petrol bombs and damage at specific stages; they do not establish that all protesters or every night were violent.

state_response.arrests.summary: Some detentions are reported in the Jan25–28 sequence, including HRW’s reported Jan25 arrests and a separate Army statement relayed by Al Jazeera. Amnesty’s 35-person Jan25–31 total is not assigned to a specific night.

state_response.beatings.summary: HRW reports protesters beaten during the Jan25 response; later detainee torture allegations are not transferred to the street event.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: HRW describes Jan25/26 dispersals using tear gas and rubber projectiles; Al Araby describes gas/water use at the Serail on Jan28.

state_response.shootings.summary: Live ammunition is reported in the Jan27 night response; live fire is kept distinct from gas and rubber projectiles.

state_response.killings.summary: One demonstrator, Omar Tayba, died after a bullet wound during Jan27 clashes. Amnesty relays his brother’s account that ISF fired at the ground before a ricochet struck Omar; HRW’s footage review links ISF fire and a person falling while recording the commander’s unidentified-bullet account. L’Orient Today corrected the reported second death: Osama Ghoumrawy was alive. Preserve these claims and code one reported death only.

notes: HRW retrospectively places a noon gathering on Jan25; reports describe activity through Jan28. Keep the sequence provisional rather than summing nights. Jan31 followed a reported lull and may be a resumption. Al Jazeera relayed a mayoral second-death claim that L’Orient Today corrected: Osama Ghoumrawy was alive. One Jan27/28 death remains with disputed attribution.
open_questions: Determine nightly event-unit boundaries and whether Jan31 is a resumption; resolve day-count conflict and physical end; keep casualties and detentions scoped to the dates and source claims.

title: Tripoli Al-Nour solidarity gathering after the lockdown-protest crackdown
location: Al-Nour Square and Serail vicinity, Tripoli
scope: Tripoli gathering with convoys arriving from other regions; origin locations are not separate crowds without independent evidence
participants_original: L’Orient-Le Jour reports several hundred at Al-Nour around 16:00. One participant’s estimate of about 100 in his Beirut convoy is not additive.
threshold_50_evidence: Several hundred at Al-Nour around 16:00 is above 50; do not add convoy estimates or later attendees.

start_date.summary: L’Orient-Le Jour identifies Sunday Jan31; Al Jazeera’s Feb1 report describes renewed Sunday clashes after a brief lull.

end_date.summary: Reporting continues into the evening but does not establish physical end.

location.summary: Several hundred at Al-Nour; later stones and tear gas near the Serail. Separate Baalbek sit-in of about ten is excluded.

demands.summary: Reports cite deteriorating living conditions and strict lockdown, solidarity and criticism of political leadership; the precise state action sought on Jan31 needs clarification.

participants_original.summary: Several hundred at Al-Nour around 16:00; one Beirut convoy estimate is not added.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Several hundred at Al-Nour is over 50.

protester_violence.summary: Afternoon crowd was calm; a smaller later group threw stones during renewed clashes.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Security forces used tear gas during later clashes; keep this response separate from the calm afternoon.

notes: Keep the calm afternoon assembly separate from later stone-throwing and tear gas. Al Jazeera’s 17 detainees/10 injuries refer to recent days, not specifically Jan31. This may resume the Jan25–28 sequence after a short lull; do not count it automatically as a new campaign.
open_questions: Clarify event relationship to Jan25–28, explicit state demand, physical end, and any date-specific arrests or injuries.
